summary: become can be controlled by play/task directives, connection variables or the command line; precedence rules decide which wins, and a list of become plugins is available.
questions: Where can I configure become in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Ways to control become
answer_card.answer_md: Set `become` via play or task **directives**, **connection variables**, or the **command line**. If set in several places, Ansible's general precedence rules decide.
